## Checklist

Before requesting review, please ensure the following where applicable:

- [ ] The PR is limited in scope and addresses a single, clear change or improvement.
- [ ] All new or changed documentation is included and clear (README, docs/, folder-level READMEs).
- [ ] Any scripts or notebooks include a short README describing how to run them and which dependencies are required.
- [ ] No sensitive data, secrets, proprietary files, or personally identifiable information (PII) are included in this PR.
- [ ] For research artifacts: include data provenance, licensing notes, and a reproducibility checklist in the relevant folder.
- [ ] CI checks (if present) pass and any linting issues are addressed.
